title: Expression generic and join owner release

scope.rationale: Compiler ownership now has source-shaped generic expression cleanup and mutually exclusive ON/USING cleanup wrappers.

dependencies.caller_closure: Both complete cleanup wrappers are translated over source-layout owners.

inputs: Connection plus nullable generic expression pointer or OnOrUsing owner
outputs: Present expression or mutually exclusive ON/USING child consumed
contracts.ownership: Consumes one represented child; ON takes precedence exactly as source.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No I/O; caller owns parser synchronization.

representation_differences: Typed alignment cast converts the generic cleanup pointer; OnOrUsing fields are explicit optionals.

oracle.protocol: Release null/generic expression and null/ON/USING join owners.

assurance.malformed_input: Generic pointer must reference aligned Expr; source ON/USING exclusivity applies.
assurance.performance: Wrapper constant time plus child destruction.

integration.native_call_path: parser cleanup/join owner cleanup -> generic or ON/USING destructor

known_blockers: Wire cleanup callback and join parser callers with focused allocator trace.

upstream_tests: Project parser and broad runtime tests
